Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a practical, hands-on approach. Ability to work independently and safely in a remote operational environment. Strong work ethic and willingness to contribute across multiple operational activities. Effective communication and collaboration skills. title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices

  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.

title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.
  • CV.
  • A complete list of publications.
  • Project/research plan aligned with the position scope
  • Transcripts and certificates.
  • Contact information for 2-3 references.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

description: Grafton ICT* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito AI, Data, Cybersecurity, Cloud, ERP & CRM, Sistemi e Infrastrutture, IMAC e Sviluppo. Per ampliamento nostro network di candidati specializzati, ricerchiamo candidati e candidate interessati/e a valutare opportunità come: RAMS / ILS ENGINEER Le posizioni che potremo proporti potranno includere attività quali: Guidare le attività RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety) lungo il ciclo di vita del prodotto; definire gli obiettivi RAM, allocare i requisiti e pianificare i programmi RAM (previsioni, suddivisione, crescita). Eseguire analisi di affidabilità (MIL-HDBK-217F, parts-count/physics-of-failure), modellazione di disponibilità e costi del ciclo di vita (MTBF/MTTR, Ao) e analisi di manutenibilità (tempi delle attività, dimostrazioni di manutenibilità). Realizzare ingegneria della sicurezza secondo ARP4754A/ARP4761 e MIL-STD-882E: FHA, FTA/ETA, PRA, classificazione dei rischi e monitoraggio delle mitigazioni. Implementare e gestire il processo FRACAS per la raccolta dei difetti di campo/test, analisi delle cause radice, azioni correttive/preventive e crescita dell'affidabilità (es. Crow-AMSAA). Guidare l'Integrated Product Support (IPS/ILS): LSA/LSAR secondo ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F); sviluppare banche dati di supporto logistico (LSDB), elenchi ricambi, attrezzature di supporto (STTE), piani di manutenzione e allineamento della documentazione tecnica (S1000D). Condurre analisi FMEA/FMECA e MTA/RCM; raccomandare modifiche progettuali e miglioramenti alla supportabilità (DfR, DfM, DfS, DfMtn). Gestire la governance dell'obsolescenza: monitoraggio del ciclo di vita, pianificazione Last Time Buy (LTB), ricerca di soluzioni Fit-Form-Function (FFF) alternative, analisi degli impatti d'uso e report di chiusura. Definire i supporti ai test e qualifiche (ambientale/elettrica/EMC) e contribuire alle verifiche di conformità ed accettazione (FAT/SAT). Realizzare dashboard e monitoraggio KPI per le performance RAMS/ILS; pubblicare report periodici e supportare i review di progetto (SRR/PDR/CDR). Mantenere un solido controllo di configurazione in PLM/ERP; garantire la conformità a qualità (ISO 9001/EN 9100), HSE e alle politiche di sicurezza delle informazioni/export-control. Hai queste caratteristiche? Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria o discipline STEM affini. Competenza nell'uso di strumenti RAMS (es. Windchill Quality Solutions/ReliaSoft), sistemi di requisiti/PLM/ERP (es. DOORS/DOORS Next, Teamcenter, SAP) e analisi dati (Excel/Power BI; SQL). Conoscenza degli standard ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F), MIL-STD-1388 (LSA/LSAR) e dei principali framework di safety engineering (ARP4754A/ARP4761, MIL-STD-882E). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica in inglese (report di supportabilità, FMECA/FHA/FTA, piani di manutenzione, estratti LSDB) e di gestire baseline/variazioni di configurazione. Luogo di lavoro: Roma, Genova, Torino, Firenze Entrando nel nostro data-base, potremo contattarti quando saranno disponibili posizioni coerenti con la tua esperienza, le tue competenze e la tua disponibilità. title: Mining, manufacturing and construction supervisors
description: Per conto di una realtà industriale strutturata, operante in ambito Alimentare, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Head of Quality (QHSE). La posizione riveste un ruolo strategico all'interno dell'organizzazione e prevede la responsabilità complessiva della definizione, implementazione e governo dei sistemi di qualità, sicurezza e conformità lungo l'intera catena del valore. Il contesto è caratterizzato da processi produttivi complessi, elevati standard operativi e un'interazione costante con stakeholder interni ed esterni, tra cui clienti, enti certificatori e autorità competenti. La figura contribuirà in modo diretto al presidio e all'evoluzione del Sistema di Gestione Qualità (SGQ/QMS), assicurando il rispetto degli standard normativi e delle best practice di settore e promuovendo una cultura diffusa orientata al miglioramento continuo (CI). In questo ambito, avrà la responsabilità di definire la strategia qualità, supportando il top management nell'individuazione e nella gestione dei rischi legati a qualità, sicurezza e compliance. Tra le principali responsabilità rientrano la gestione e il continuo aggiornamento dei sistemi di qualità, con riferimento ai principali standard, tra cui HACCP, IFS e ISO, nonché la supervisione delle policy aziendali e della documentazione tecnica. La risorsa sarà responsabile della gestione strutturata delle non conformità e dei reclami, attraverso l'implementazione di processi CAPA e attività di root cause analysis, e guiderà il monitoraggio dei KPI di qualità e performance, contribuendo allo sviluppo di iniziative di miglioramento continuo. Il ruolo prevede inoltre la supervisione degli audit interni, delle verifiche da parte dei clienti e degli enti certificatori, nonché la gestione delle relazioni con organismi di controllo e fornitori. Sarà inoltre responsabile del mantenimento e dello sviluppo delle certificazioni aziendali e del presidio dei processi di qualifica e monitoraggio dei fornitori. Dal punto di vista organizzativo, la figura guiderà il team qualità, coordinando risorse tecniche e laboratori, e rappresenterà un punto di riferimento trasversale per le principali funzioni aziendali, tra cui Produzione, Supply Chain, Acquisti e Manutenzione. Avrà inoltre un ruolo chiave nel garantire la coerenza tra gli standard definiti e la loro applicazione operativa nei processi produttivi, con particolare attenzione agli aspetti di sicurezza, igiene, tracciabilità e conformità documentale. Il profilo ideale ha maturato un'esperienza consolidata in ruoli di responsabilità nella funzione qualità, all'interno di contesti produttivi strutturati, e possiede una solida conoscenza dei sistemi SGQ/QMS e dei principali standard normativi e di certificazione. Completano il profilo una spiccata leadership, capacità di operare in contesti complessi, forte orientamento al risultato e al miglioramento continuo, nonché eccellenti capacità relazionali e di gestione degli stakeholder. La posizione si inserisce in un contesto dinamico e in evoluzione, offrendo la possibilità di contribuire in maniera significativa allo sviluppo dei processi e al rafforzamento del sistema qualità aziendale. #LI-CP Wyser è il brand globale che si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive di Gi Group Holding, la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro e una tra le principali realtà che offrono servizi e consulenza HR a livello globale. description: Grafton ICT* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito AI, Data, Cybersecurity, Cloud, ERP & CRM, Sistemi e Infrastrutture, IMAC e Sviluppo. Per ampliamento nostro network di candidati specializzati, ricerchiamo candidati e candidate interessati/e a valutare opportunità come: RAMS / ILS ENGINEER Le posizioni che potremo proporti potranno includere attività quali: Guidare le attività RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety) lungo il ciclo di vita del prodotto; definire gli obiettivi RAM, allocare i requisiti e pianificare i programmi RAM (previsioni, suddivisione, crescita). Eseguire analisi di affidabilità (MIL-HDBK-217F, parts-count/physics-of-failure), modellazione di disponibilità e costi del ciclo di vita (MTBF/MTTR, Ao) e analisi di manutenibilità (tempi delle attività, dimostrazioni di manutenibilità). Realizzare ingegneria della sicurezza secondo ARP4754A/ARP4761 e MIL-STD-882E: FHA, FTA/ETA, PRA, classificazione dei rischi e monitoraggio delle mitigazioni. Implementare e gestire il processo FRACAS per la raccolta dei difetti di campo/test, analisi delle cause radice, azioni correttive/preventive e crescita dell'affidabilità (es. Crow-AMSAA). Guidare l'Integrated Product Support (IPS/ILS): LSA/LSAR secondo ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F); sviluppare banche dati di supporto logistico (LSDB), elenchi ricambi, attrezzature di supporto (STTE), piani di manutenzione e allineamento della documentazione tecnica (S1000D). Condurre analisi FMEA/FMECA e MTA/RCM; raccomandare modifiche progettuali e miglioramenti alla supportabilità (DfR, DfM, DfS, DfMtn). Gestire la governance dell'obsolescenza: monitoraggio del ciclo di vita, pianificazione Last Time Buy (LTB), ricerca di soluzioni Fit-Form-Function (FFF) alternative, analisi degli impatti d'uso e report di chiusura. Definire i supporti ai test e qualifiche (ambientale/elettrica/EMC) e contribuire alle verifiche di conformità ed accettazione (FAT/SAT). Realizzare dashboard e monitoraggio KPI per le performance RAMS/ILS; pubblicare report periodici e supportare i review di progetto (SRR/PDR/CDR). Mantenere un solido controllo di configurazione in PLM/ERP; garantire la conformità a qualità (ISO 9001/EN 9100), HSE e alle politiche di sicurezza delle informazioni/export-control. Hai queste caratteristiche? Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria o discipline STEM affini. Competenza nell'uso di strumenti RAMS (es. Windchill Quality Solutions/ReliaSoft), sistemi di requisiti/PLM/ERP (es. DOORS/DOORS Next, Teamcenter, SAP) e analisi dati (Excel/Power BI; SQL). Conoscenza degli standard ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F), MIL-STD-1388 (LSA/LSAR) e dei principali framework di safety engineering (ARP4754A/ARP4761, MIL-STD-882E). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica in inglese (report di supportabilità, FMECA/FHA/FTA, piani di manutenzione, estratti LSDB) e di gestire baseline/variazioni di configurazione. Luogo di lavoro: Roma, Genova, Torino, Firenze Entrando nel nostro data-base, potremo contattarti quando saranno disponibili posizioni coerenti con la tua esperienza, le tue competenze e la tua disponibilità. description: Il settore Commerciale ti ha sempre affascinato? Ti piacerebbe svolgere un percorso di formazione gratuito per lavorare in Supermercati e Negozi di vendita al dettaglio? Questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità giusta per te! La frequenza consente, in presenza dei requisiti previsti, il riconoscimento del Bonus Politiche Attive, da richiedere presso il Centro per l'Impiego (CPI) competente del territorio. MES, IoT, Database) e delle attività di logistica; - Conoscenza fluente della lingua inglese, del pacchetto office e dei moduli SAP relativi alla gestione del magazzino; - Sono inoltre richieste buone capacità relazionali, in quanto ti interfaccerai con vari reparti aziendali; Orario di lavoro: Dal Lunedì al Venerdì con orario 8.00-17.00 o 9.00-18.00 con flessibilità in entrata e uscita Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento: contratto di somministrazione tempo determinato di 6 mesi CCNL applicato: CCNL Metalmeccanica Industria Livello di inquadramento: C3 con accordo integrativo di secondo livello Retribuzione: La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35000 e € 40000 lordi annui, definita in base all' inquadramento contrattuale, alle mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. Realizzare ingegneria della sicurezza secondo ARP4754A/ARP4761 e MIL-STD-882E: FHA, FTA/ETA, PRA, classificazione dei rischi e monitoraggio delle mitigazioni. Implementare e gestire il processo FRACAS per la raccolta dei difetti di campo/test, analisi delle cause radice, azioni correttive/preventive e crescita dell'affidabilità (es. Crow-AMSAA). Guidare l'Integrated Product Support (IPS/ILS): LSA/LSAR secondo ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F); sviluppare banche dati di supporto logistico (LSDB), elenchi ricambi, attrezzature di supporto (STTE), piani di manutenzione e allineamento della documentazione tecnica (S1000D). Condurre analisi FMEA/FMECA e MTA/RCM; raccomandare modifiche progettuali e miglioramenti alla supportabilità (DfR, DfM, DfS, DfMtn). Gestire la governance dell'obsolescenza: monitoraggio del ciclo di vita, pianificazione Last Time Buy (LTB), ricerca di soluzioni Fit-Form-Function (FFF) alternative, analisi degli impatti d'uso e report di chiusura. Definire i supporti ai test e qualifiche (ambientale/elettrica/EMC) e contribuire alle verifiche di conformità ed accettazione (FAT/SAT). title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.
  • CV.
  • A complete list of publications.
  • Project/research plan aligned with the position scope
  • Transcripts and certificates.
  • Contact information for 2-3 references.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: responsabile di deposito

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: OPERATOR BESCHICHTUNG (all genders)
description:

ländlejobs ist ein dynamisches und zukunftsorientiertes Stellenvermittlungsbüro mit Fokus Fürstentum Liechtenstein und der angrenzenden Ostschweiz.

Wir decken die Bereiche Stellenvermittlung und Temporärpersonal ab, wobei wir den Schwerpunkt unserer Rekrutierung auf qualifiziertes Fachpersonal für Industrie, Handwerk und Gewerbe legen.

Als regional verankerter Anbieter achten wir bei der Rekrutierung unserer Bewerber, stets auf eine gute berufliche Qualifikation und einen bereits vorhandenen Bezug zu unserer engeren Region.

OPERATOR BESCHICHTUNG (all genders)

Aufgaben:
- Einrichten und bedienen mehrerer Beschichtungsanlagen
- Vorbereiten und Instandhaltung von Beschichtungswerkzeugen
- Führung der Anlagen und Prozessdokumentationen inkl. Pflegen der Hilfsblätter
- Spektralmessungen der beschichteten Produkte und Spezifikationsüberprüfung
- Reinigung und Wartung der Beschichtungsanlagen

- Bedienung von Reinigungsanlagen und einhalten von Reinigungsplänen
- Instandhalten und Pflegen von Arbeitsmaterial und Hilfsmittel
- Elektronische Datenerfassung gem. Vorgabe (ERP und CAQ)
- Verantwortung für Qualität und Einhaltung der Q-Richtlinien.
- Sauberkeit am Arbeitsplatz
- Selbständiges Zeitmanagement und Verantwortung für das Einhalten von Fristen.

Anforderungen:
- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung bevorzugt
- Erfahrung mit Vakuum und/oder Sputterbeschichtungsanlagen von Vorteil
- Manuelles Geschick, sehr gute Feinmotorik, gutes Sehvermögen

- Flexibilität, Teamfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit
- Sorgfältige, konzentrierte und selbständige Arbeitsweise
- PC-Kenntnisse von Vorteil
- Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Für die ausgeschriebene Stelle wird ein attraktives und leistungsorientiertes Gehalt geboten. Die genauen Anstellungsbedingungen richten sich nach Ihrer Ausbildung, Tätigkeit, Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung!
Es handelt sich um eine temporäre Anstellung mit Option auf eine spätere Fixanstellung.

Im Sinne des Gesetzes über die Gleichstellung von Mann und Frau (GLG), richtet sich unser Stellenangebot sowohl an männliche, als auch an weibliche Bewerber.

Sie haben Interesse? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen.

description:
Wir suchen im Homeoffice eine/n offene/n, empathische/n und kommunikationsstarke/n
**Gesundheitsberater / Gesundheits-Coach (Quereinstieg)**

Sind Sie bereit für eine sinnstiftende berufliche Neuorientierung? Wir sind zukunftsorientiert im Bereich Healty Longevity (Langes gesundes Leben unterwegs. Hier suchen wir Sie mit Lebenserfahrung, die Menschen auf ihrem Weg zu einem gesünderen Leben begleiten möchten. Auch ohne klassische Ausbildung im medizinischen Bereich ermöglichen wir Ihnen einen erfolgreichen Quereinstieg.

**Ihre Aufgaben: Was Sie erwartet**

Kunden/Interessenten Gewinnung Betreuung und Beratung
•     Sie führen Beratungsgespräche mit unseren Interessierten Kundinnen und Kunden (persönlich oder online).
•    Lösungsfindung: Sie unterstützen unsere Klienten dabei, gesundheitliche Ziele zu definieren und im Alltag umzusetzen (z.B. in den Bereichen Ernährung, Bewegung und Stressmanagement).
•    Begleitung: Sie fungieren als kontinuierlicher Ansprechpartner/in und motivieren unsere Kundinnen und Kunden auf ihrem Weg.
•    Administration: Sie erfassen die Beratungsgespräche und verwalten diese.
Ihr Profil: Was Sie mitbringen
•    Berufserfahrung: Sie haben bereits Berufserfahrung in einem anderen Tätigkeitsfeld gesammelt (z.B. aus Kundendienst, HR, Vertrieb, Pädagogik, Gastronomie oder Fitness).
•    Lebenskompetenz: Sie verfügen über eine hohe soziale Kompetenz, Empathie und ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Gesundheitsthemen.
•    Kommunikationstalent: Sie sind ein starker Kommunikator, der gut zuhören kann und komplexe Dinge verständlich erklärt.
•    Sprachkenntnisse: Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Gute mündliche Kenntnisse Schweizerdeutsch(weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus).
•    Lernbereitschaft: Sie haben Freude daran, sich neues Fachwissen im Bereich Gesundheit und Prävention anzueignen.

**Unser Angebot: Was wir Ihnen bieten**
•    Strukturierter Quereinstieg: Ein umfassendes Einarbeitungsprogramm inkl. Mentoring.
•    Aus- und Weiterbildung: Interne berufsbegleitende zum zertifizierten Healthy Longevity Coach HLV Akad,).
•    Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit: Ein Job, bei dem die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden von Menschen im Mittelpunkt stehen.
•    Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen: Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Homeoffice
•    Faire Entlöhnung: Ein attraktives Gehaltspacket sowie gute Sozialleistungen.

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt?

title: Direktoriaus pavaduotojas (-a) ūkio reikalams
description:
Vadovauti tiesiogiai pavaldiems darbuotojams, teikti jiems pagalbą, prižiūrėti jų darbą ir atsakyti už jų darbo rezultatus.
Organizuoti ūkinę veiklą, priešgaisrinę saugą, civilinę saugą,  darbo saugą, nelaimingų atsitikimų tyrimą, darbuotojų saugos ir sveikatos priežiūrą lopšelyje – darželyje bei tvarkyti reikiamus dokumentus.
Vykdyti lopšelio-darželio teritorijos, pastatų ir patalpų, baldų, inventoriaus priežiūrą, pildyti atitinkamus dokumentus, organizuoti patalpų remonto darbus ir inventoriaus remontą.
Tikrinti apšvietimo, šildymo, vėdinimo, kanalizacijos, vandentiekio ir kitų lopšelyje – darželyje esančių sistemų būklę, organizuoti gedimų šalinimą bei užtikrinti jų normalų veikimą.
Rūpintis lopšelio–darželio ilgalaikio turto, atsargų įsigijimu, jų apskaita, aprūpinti būtinais materialiniais resursais (baldais, inventoriumi, kompiuteriais, kanceliarijos, švaros priemonėmis ir kt.)
Vykdyti ilgalaikio turto, atsargų (ūkio inventoriaus) apskaitą, sudaryti jų inventorizacijos aprašus – sutikrinimo žiniaraščius.
Organizuoti viešuosius pirkimus pagal lopšelyje-darželyje nustatytą tvarką, tvarkyti viešųjų pirkimų dokumentus ir (ar) dalyvauti viešųjų pirkimų komisijoje.
Dalyvauti vykdant finansavimo apskaitą, rengiant finansines ataskaitas bei pateikti reikalingą informaciją finansinėms ataskaitoms parengti.
Dalyvauti strateginio plano, metinio veiklos plano rengime ir įgyvendinime.
Rengti ir dalyvauti rengiant, įgyvendinant metines turto programas, lopšelio-darželio pastatų einamojo remonto planus, sąmatas ir kt.
Atsižvelgiant į higienos normų reikalavimus, užtikrinti saugias lopšelio-darželio darbuotojų darbo sąlygas.
Rengti įsakymų projektus susijusius su ūkio reikalais, viešaisiais pirkimais.
Vykdyti kitus, su įstaigos veiklos tikslais, funkcijomis ir savo tiesioginiu darbu susijusius, įstaigos direktoriaus teisėtus pavedimus ir užduotis.

title: Medic. įrangos priež. tarnybos specialistas

dalyvauti demontuojant naudotą medicinos įrangą ir paruošiant patalpas naujos įrangos montavimui;
fiksuoti informaciją apie atliktą techninę priežiūrą, remontą, gedimus, panaudotas detales ir atliktus darbus medicinos įrangos techniniuose pasuose, žurnaluose ar kitose apskaitos formose;
informuoti tiesioginį vadovą apie nustatytas problemas, gedimus ar rizikas.

title: Darbininkas (-ė)
description:
Prisijunk Statinių administravimo grupės Kauno technologijos universitete!
Darbininkas Statinių administravimo grupėje Kauno technologijos universitete prižiūri pastatus, atlieka smulkius remonto darbus, šalina gedimus ir užtikrina tvarkingą bei saugią aplinką.

Jei mėgsti darbą lauke, darbuotis su technika ir vertini aiškiai matomą savo darbo rezultatą – kviečiame tave prisidėti prie Universiteto aplinkos priežiūros.
Čia turėsi galimybę dirbti savarankiškai, rūpintis tvarkinga ir jaukia aplinka bei būti svarbia komandos dalimi.

Tapk KTU komandos dalimi ir kurk ateitį kartu su mumis!

Kasdienės užduotys:
- Universiteto teritorijų priežiūra ir tvarkymas;
- darbas su traktoriais: žolės pjovimas, lapų rinkimas, sniego valymas, takų ir aikštelių šlavimas;
- teritorijų tvarkymo darbai pagal sezoniškumą;
- technikos priežiūra ir smulkūs remonto darbai;
- tvarkingas darbo inventoriaus naudojimas;
- želdinių priežiūra.

title: Pastatų priežiūros tarnybos vedėjas (-a)
employer: Nacionalinis M. K. Čiurlionio dailės muziejus
description:

2.    Užtikrinti muziejaus pastatų, inžinerinių sistemų, teritorijų ir transporto priemonių techninę priežiūrą, remontą bei operatyvų avarinių situacijų valdymą.
3.    Koordinuoti ekspozicijų ir parodų techninį įrengimą, eksponatų transportavimą bei sudaryti tinkamas kultūros vertybių saugojimo sąlygas.
4.    Organizuoti viešuosius pirkimus pagal kompetenciją, rengti technines specifikacijas, kontroliuoti sutarčių vykdymą bei planuoti tarnybos biudžetą.
5.    Analizuoti infrastruktūros veiklos rodiklius, teikti siūlymus dėl remonto prioritetų, energijos taupymo ir veiklos efektyvinimo.
6.    Užtikrinti darbuotojų saugos, priešgaisrinės saugos ir kitų teisės aktų reikalavimų laikymąsi, bendradarbiauti su rangovais, paslaugų teikėjais ir institucijomis.

description: Ieškome atsakingo, iniciatyvaus ir darbštaus plataus profilio darbuotojo, kuris prisijungtų prie mūsų komandos ir prisidėtų prie kasdienių įmonės techninių bei ūkinių darbų. Prižiūrėti informaciją apie traukinių parko techninę būklę, įskaitant esmines keleivių aptarnavimo sistemas.

Organizuoti traukinių, traukinio įgulų kelionių, užduočių ir grafikų vykdymą, atlikti pakeitimus pagal veiklos poreikį, sutrikimus ar resursų pokyčius

title: Energetikas (-ė) / VMG Service Akmenė
description:
„VMG Service Akmenė“ ieško energetiko (-ės), kuris (-i) prisidėtų prie VMG grupės įmonių, veikiančių Akmenės LEZ, elektros ūkio ir priešgaisrinių sistemų priežiūros. Stebėti įrenginių rodiklius ir ruošti ataskaitas pagal poreikį;
Sudaryti įrenginių ir tinklų derinimo, bandymų, remonto grafikus, eksploatavimo instrukcijas, valdymo schemas;
Užtikrinti sklandų elektromonterių darbų vykdymą;
Atlikti sudėtingus ir paprastus elektros perjungimus;
Energijos nuostolių susidarymo priežasčių analizė ir prevencija.

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

L'ACD est également un acteur clé de la transformation numérique de l'administration publique et de l'amélioration continue des services offerts aux citoyens. title: JUNIOR ENGINEER IN NETWORK ARCHITECTURE AND DISTRIBUTED SENSING (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
SD-26130-JUNIOR ENGINEER IN NETWORK ARCHITECTURE AND DISTRIBUTED SENSING
Fixed term contract | Belval | 12 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

Describe the main responsibilities of the position.

As a Junior R&T Engineer in the NETCOM group, you will contribute to cutting-edge research on wireless network architectures and distributed communication systems, with applications spanning aerial and space platforms. Under the supervision of experienced researchers and engineers, your main responsibilities will include:
• Network architecture design: Contribute to the definition and modelling of communication network architectures for multi-node distributed systems, including the specification of inter-node link technologies, bandwidth and latency requirements, and Quality of Service (QoS) classes.
• Protocol development: Assist in the design and implementation of cross-layer communication protocols, covering message prioritization, timing constraints, synchronization logic, and fault-tolerant fallback mechanisms for degraded link conditions.
• System integration: Support the definition of data formats and interface specifications required for the integration of communication layers with onboard sensing, processing, and command chain components.
• Simulation and performance evaluation: Develop and run simulation models to evaluate network performance under realistic operational conditions, contributing to the validation and benchmarking of proposed architectural solutions.
• Prototyping and testing: Assist in the implementation and laboratory testing of communication modules, including SDR-based platforms and protocol stacks, contributing to the validation of prototypes in controlled environments.
• Documentation and reporting: Contribute to the drafting of technical deliverables, scientific publications, and presentations at project meetings or conferences.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

• Master's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.
• Studies covering one or more of the following topics: wireless communication systems and protocols, network architecture and design, distributed systems, artificial intelligence, software-defined networking, or embedded systems.

Experience and skills

• 0 to 2 years of relevant professional or research experience (including internships and Master's thesis work) in wireless networks, communication protocol design, or distributed time-sensitive systems.
• Good understanding of network architecture design principles, including protocol stack design, Quality of Service (QoS), and link management.
• Familiarity with inter-node communication and coordination protocols for distributed or multi-agent systems.
• Knowledge of wireless communication technologies and standards.
• Programming skills in Python, C/C++, or MATLAB for simulation, performance evaluation, and protocol implementation.
• Familiarity with network simulation tools (e.g., ns-3, OMNET++, or equivalent).
• Ability to work under supervision while progressively developing autonomy.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to interpret results and formulate conclusions.
• Collaborative mindset, comfortable working in a multidisciplinary and international consortium environment.

Language skills
• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square meters, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfill their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:

• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
• A CV with contact details

Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.

Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.

As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

Due to the requirements of the project, we can only consider applications from nationals of a NATO Member Country, from an EU EEA/EFTA Country or from one of the following NATO Indo-Pacific Partners, Australia, Japan, Republic of South Korea and New Zealand.
This position offers a gross monthly salary between €5043 and €5527, paid over 13 months (€65559–€71851 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience .

For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata.

It is to be noted that LIST also offers real opportunities for career growth, both in terms of responsibilities and salary progression, as employees develop within LIST.

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

Describe the main responsibilities of the position.

Refrigeration and air conditioning account for ~17% of global energy consumption, a figure expected to triple by 2050, while contributing over 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions. Conventional vapor-compression cooling relies on high–global-warming-potential refrigerants, creating an urgent need for energy-efficient and environmentally friendly alternatives. Electrocaloric cooling is a promising solid-state technology that can be up to 20% more efficient than vapor-compression systems. It uses ferroelectric materials that undergo a reversible temperature change under an applied electric field. The materials heats upon application and cools upon removal of an electric field. LIST has been working on the topic for some years, specifically developing electrocaloric prototypes based on ceramics and polymers. LIST is recognized as one of the leading institutes in the field.

The role played by materials thermal conductivity on the behaviour of electrocaloric coolers is central to enable a proper understanding of the system. Therefore, this post doc is about studying the thermal conductivity of electrocaloric materials in the context of cooling devices. More specifically, one part will be devoted to the design and fabrication of heat exchangers integrated in electrocaloric coolers. The impact of materials and their thickness will be assessed in specific devices. Another part of this post doc will be devoted to the study of heat switches associated with electrocaloric materials, enabling the design of fluid-free cooling devices.

title: Cost Management Team Leader (m/f)
description:
Cost Management Team Leader (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1125


Back to Search

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your next challenge:

• Lead the Bank's cost management framework, ensuring effective financial steering of operating expenses, investment spending, and strategic initiatives across all business units.
• Act as a trusted Finance partner to Senior Management and business leaders by providing insightful analysis, challenging spending decisions, identifying optimization opportunities, and ensuring alignment with the Bank's strategic objectives.
• Support Executive Management, the CFO and senior governance bodies in evaluating strategic projects, transformation initiatives, investments and acquisitions through robust financial analysis and business case assessments.
• Develop a strong cost-conscious culture across the organization while ensuring resources are allocated efficiently to support growth, regulatory requirements, operational resilience and strategic ambitions.
• Lead and develop a high-performing team responsible for cost controlling, planning, analysis and management reporting.
• Own and continuously enhance the Bank's cost management framework, policies and governance.
• Lead the budget and forecasting processes for operating expenses and investment spending.
• Monitor cost performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying risks, opportunities and corrective actions.
• Lead the evolution of the Bank's cost allocation framework, ensuring transparent, accurate and business-relevant allocation of costs across customers, products, channels and business units to support profitability analysis, pricing decisions and strategic resource allocation.
• Act as primary Finance partner for senior executives, department heads and business leaders regarding cost management matters.
• Organize and lead periodic cost review meetings with ExCo members and senior management.
• Challenge business assumptions, investment requests and resource allocation decisions through a constructive and data-driven approach.
• Build strong relationships across Finance, COO, Risk, HR, CEO Office and Business Lines to ensure alignment on financial priorities.
• Support Management in evaluating strategic projects and transformation initiatives.
• Perform financial assessments of acquisitions, partnerships and strategic opportunities.
• Evaluate expected benefits, costs, risks and return on investment of major initiatives.
• Deliver timely, accurate and insightful management reporting on costs and investment performance.
• Conduct ad-hoc financial analyses and simulations on business initiatives, cost drivers and strategic options.
• Drive improvements in planning methodologies, management reporting and analytical capabilities.
• Promote automation and digitalization of cost management processes.
• Contribute to the evolution of Finance tools, data governance and performance management frameworks.
• Lead, coach and develop the Cost Management team.
• Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and high performance.
• Ensure appropriate succession planning, talent development and capability building within the team.

Your skills:

• Master's Degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or related field. CFA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent qualifications considered an advantage.
• Minimum 12-15 years of experience in FP&A, Finance Business Partnering, Cost Management, Corporate Finance, Strategy or related fields within financial services.
• Minimum 5 years in leadership positions managing teams and engaging directly with executive management.
• Fluency in French and English. Luxembourgish and/or German considered an asset.
• Strong understanding of banking products, business models, profitability drivers, financial planning processes and performance management. Knowledge of banking regulatory environment and capital considerations is an advantage.
• Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills. Strong knowledge of financial planning, reporting and data visualization tools. Experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) systems, Power BI, Microstrategy, or similar tools is a plus.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Ability to engage and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
• Strategic mindset combined with strong analytical capabilities.
• Excellent presentation skills and ability to translate complex financial information into actionable recommendations.
• Strong leadership and change management capabilities.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.
